title: Architectural Design
subtitle: Form, context, and tactile permanence
summary: Comprehensive architectural masterplanning and building design responding to site, climate, light, and materiality.
description: Our architectural practice approaches every commission from first principles—analyzing daylight angles, microclimatic breezes, spatial proportions, and local material traditions. We design enduring residential, commercial, and institutional structures that age gracefully alongside the natural landscape.
deliverables: Site analysis, solar geometry, and contextual planning
Concept design, volumetric massing, and architectural narratives
Detailed architectural drafting, BIM coordination, and working drawings
Statutory municipal approvals and liaison documentation
Site supervision, material benchmarking, and construction review

title: Residential Architecture
subtitle: Sanctuaries tailored to human life
summary: Bespoke villas, family residences, and multi-generational homes designed around private courtyards and verdant living.
description: From suburban retreats like Vairaag and Pramukh Villa to grand four-level residences like Shayonam, our residential work crafts homes that nurture deep family life. We focus on seamless indoor-outdoor transitions, acoustic tranquility, and honest materials such as exposed brick and raw concrete.
deliverables: Custom villa and private bungalow architecture
Multi-generational spatial zoning and private suites
Courtyard, verandah, and landscape integration
Climatically responsive building envelope design
Bespoke architectural detailing and fenestration

title: Interior Architecture
subtitle: Material honesty, light, and artisan craft
summary: Holistic interior environments balancing modern minimalist elegance with authentic Indian artisanal craft traditions.
description: We treat interior architecture not as superficial decoration, but as an intimate sculptural continuation of the building itself. We specify natural marbles, warm teakwood, textured Oikos plasters, custom CNC metal screens, and tailored mood lighting to evoke quiet, enduring luxury.
deliverables: Spatial layout optimization and volumetric flow
Bespoke cabinetry, custom furniture design, and joinery details
Material, texture, and colour palette curation
Architectural lighting design and circadian illumination
Art curation, ethnic motifs, and soft furnishing styling

title: Commercial & Workplace
subtitle: Inspiring environments with lasting brand identity
summary: Distinctive commercial headquarters, experience centers, and corporate site offices that elevate daily work.
description: As demonstrated in the Isha Developers Office, our commercial architecture transcends generic corporate environments. We craft tactile, permanent workplaces centered around natural green courtyards, exposed masonry, and dignified spaces that leave a memorable impression on clients and teams alike.
deliverables: Corporate headquarters and site office architecture
Client experience centers and executive suites
Adaptive workspace planning promoting collaboration and wellness
Biophilic office courtyards and natural lighting schemes
Durable commercial-grade material specifications

title: Renovation & Adaptive Reuse
subtitle: Reimagining legacy structures with quiet dignity
summary: Sensitive structural transformations, interior modernizations, and spatial reconfigurations for established properties.
description: For existing residences and commercial properties seeking renewal, we analyze existing structural bones to introduce generous daylight, improved thermal insulation, modern amenities, and timeless aesthetic coherence while respecting original character.
deliverables: Structural assessment and feasibility studies
Spatial reconfiguration and daylight penetration planning
Façade rejuvenation and material upgrading
Modern MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) integration
Turnkey architectural design consultation
